title: Etale descent of fine log structures and morphisms
statement:
Let $T$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] with a jointly surjective etale covering $\{j_a:T_a\to T\}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. On each $T_a$ let $M_a$ be a log structure in the sense of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], fine in that it has etale-local charts by finitely generated integral monoids. Suppose the $M_a$ are equipped with isomorphisms on $T_a\times_TT_b$ [def-pc-fibre-product] compatible with their structure maps to the structure sheaf, restricting to identities on the diagonals and satisfying the cocycle condition on triple overlaps. Then there exists a fine log structure $M$ on $T$ with compatible identifications of its restrictions with $M_a$ inducing the datum, unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with those identifications. If every $M_a$ admits etale-local charts by fine saturated monoids, then $M$ does also.

Moreover, let $A,B$ be sheaves of commutative monoids on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ (their underlying presheaves of sets are sheaves, their sections are commutative monoids, and restriction maps are monoid homomorphisms), with homomorphisms $\alpha:A\to(\mathcal O_T,\cdot)$ and $\beta:B\to(\mathcal O_T,\cdot)$. Let $u_a:A|_{T_a}\to B|_{T_a}$ be homomorphisms of monoid sheaves satisfying $\beta|_{T_a}\circ u_a=\alpha|_{T_a}$ and agreeing on every double overlap. Here restriction is to the localized small etale site over $T_a$, with its structure sheaf $\mathcal O_{T_a}$. Then there is a unique homomorphism $u:A\to B$ with $\beta\circ u=\alpha$ restricting to every $u_a$. The sheaves $A$ and $B$ may be arbitrary; in particular this assertion applies to inverse-image monoid sheaves equipped with the composite structure map to $\mathcal O_T$.

source.place: Expose VIII, §3.3.8 final sentence, printed pp. 107--108 (descent from strict etale charts); Expose VI, §1.1--1.4 for fine/fs log structures. The arbitrary-monoid-sheaf morphism clause is the ordinary sheaf gluing condition applied sectionwise; it does not require the source to be a log structure.

proof.text: Apply lem-trf-fine-log-etale-descent-existence to D and the given jointly surjective etale family. This supplies M, its fineness, a labelled gluing e, and the conditional fs conclusion. This is exactly the construction-and-locality portion of the old plan; no uniqueness is assumed.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, p. 69; Expose VIII 3.3.4(ii), 3.3.8, pp. 107--108; Stacks sites.tex, Tags 04TR and 04TQ. Existence only: steps 1--4 of lem-trf-fine-log-structure-etale-descent.

proof.text: Prove the arbitrary-prelog morphism clause directly from Mathlib. Joint surjectivity gives CoversTop by Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff at the terminal etale object. The local natural transformations form compatible sections of presheafHom A B, a sheaf since B is a sheaf. FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible.existsUnique_section and presheafHomSectionsEquiv give a global natural transformation with precisely those local components. To verify the structural-map equation, use the same Hom-sheaf separatedness with the multiplicative structure sheaf as target; it is a sheaf by Scheme.isSheaf_etaleStructurePresheaf and preservation of limits by forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat. This proof works for arbitrary prelog sheaves and never uses a log axiom.

source.place: Tag 04TQ, lemma-glue-maps; the sheaf of natural transformations packages the sectionwise gluing argument.

proof.text: For two labelled gluings e of M and f of N, define the local comparison f_a^{-1} e_a sectionwise as a multiplicative natural transformation over the structure sheaf. Naturality follows from the two gluing naturality equations, and overlap equality follows by cancelling f_b in D.transition(e_a)=e_b and D.transition(f_a)=f_b. The morphism gluing just proved supplies h:M->N. Repeat in the reverse direction to get i:N->M. Their composites restrict to identities, hence are identities by separatedness of the Hom sheaf. Package h and i as the required prelog isomorphism. Any other isomorphism respecting the labels has the same local components by cancellation of f_a; Hom-sheaf separatedness gives equality of hom maps and thus of the isomorphisms. Combine with the existence and fs witnesses from the first step.

source.place: Tag 04TQ, lemma-glue-maps, applied to the comparison maps and their inverses.

lean.statement: theorem fineLogStructure_etale_descent {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian T] {ι : Type v} (U : ι → T.Etale) (hcover : ∀ x : T, ∃ (a : ι) (y : (U a).left), (U a).hom y = x) : (∀ D : FineLogEtaleDescentDatum U, ∃ (M : EtaleLogStructure T) (_hM : M.IsFine) (e : D.Gluing M), ((∀ a : ι, (D.localLog a).IsFineSaturated) → M.IsFineSaturated) ∧ ∀ (N : EtaleLogStructure T) (_hN : N.IsFine) (f : D.Gluing N), ∃! h : EtalePrelogStructure.Iso M.toEtalePrelogStructure N.toEtalePrelogStructure, ∀ (a : ι) (V : T.Etale) (g : V ⟶ U a) (s : M.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op V)), f.component a V g (h.iso.hom.app (op V) s) = e.component a V g s) ∧ (∀ (A B : EtalePrelogStructure T) (localHom : ∀ a : ι, A.LocalHom B (U a)), (∀ (a b : ι) (V : T.Etale) (f : V ⟶ U a) (g : V ⟶ U b), (localHom a).hom.app (op (Over.mk f)) = (localHom b).hom.app (op (Over.mk g))) → ∃! h : A.Hom B, ∀ (a : ι) (V : T.Etale) (f : V ⟶ U a), h.hom.app (op V) = (localHom a).hom.app (op (Over.mk f)))
